name: Riya Bhatia
bio:
Career Overview: Riya Bhatia is an Indian tennis player with experience on the ITF circuit, known for her perseverance.

Playing Style: Employs a consistent baseline game with good court coverage, favoring hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #337 (December 23, 2019)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #387 (November 25, 2019)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam main draw; active in ITF tournaments.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 2 ITF doubles titles and reached several singles quarterfinals in $15K events.

Other Highlights:
  • A steady competitor, Riya has been a regular in Indian ITF events, aiming to elevate her ranking.
